sloka: चः श्रुत्वा मन्त्रिणो ऽथार्जुनस्य ते ।यः क्षीबं स्त्रीवृतं चैव योद्धुमुत्सहते नृपम् ।स्त्रीसमक्षं कथं यत्तद्योद्धुमुत्सहसे ऽर्जुनम् ।वाशितामध्यगं मत्तं शार्दूल इव कुञ्जरम् ।। ७.३२.२९ ॥
transliteration: caḥ śrutvā mantriṇo 'thārjunasya te ।yaḥ kṣībaṁ strīvṛtaṁ caiva yoddhumutsahate nṛpam ।strīsamakṣaṁ kathaṁ yattadyoddhumutsahase 'rjunam ।vāśitāmadhyagaṁ mattaṁ śārdūla iva kuñjaram ।। 7.32.29 ॥

translations.english: Ravana's ministers, having heard Arjuna's ministers, questioned Ravana why he desired to fight an intoxicated king surrounded by women, comparing it to a tiger attacking an intoxicated elephant amidst female elephants.
